headline: The Pass-7168 E8 Z12 midpoint cocycle refines the 80-state antipodal cover to the full two-qutrit symplectic sign structure. The binary reduction eps_xy=(-1)^s for phi_xy=2s+1 is switching-covariant, and an explicit W33 base isomorphism plus switching gauge identifies it with sign(omega(v_x,v_y)) on all 540 nonedges. The two C3-orbit sheets map bijectively to all 80 nonzero F3^4 vectors, with degrees 24 commuting, 27 positive and 27 negative.
